title: Sequin Tulle Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at the wedding in this dazzling dress! Featuring shimmering sequins, delicate tulle, and romantic ruffle sleeves, this elegant design offers a flattering fit and a touch of glamour. Perfect for celebrating love in style!


Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Select based primarily on chest measurement.
Choose a smaller size for a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
